collection.title: Mitsubishi Delica / Space Gear 1996 to 2007 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Mitsubishi Delica / Space Gear 1996 - 2007 model requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is also the option to upgrade to the newer Retorfit style blade.
